newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices extended early gains in late trade on Friday as blue chips started to rebound, brokers said.
With 55 minutes of trade left, the index was up 79.38 points or 1.10 percent at 7,301.36. Turnover was a heavy T$54 billion.

Brokers noted bullish sentiment after the central bank on Thursday reiterated its decision to maintain a stable-to-loose monetary policy. "The bullish sentiment has sent blue chips, which consolidated recently, to start rebounding," said Nomura Securities analyst Amy Huang. Textiles and electronics saw the biggest gains. -- James Peng (5080815)
